rows.target: <sp(20)>Press the Dash button to move at high speed.<ab(700)>
<sp(20)>Use it to close in on the targets and destroy them.<ab(500)>

<sp(20)>To stop dashing,
press the Dash button again.<ab(500)>

<sp(20)>You can also make a quick turn
by pressing the button twice in succession. Remember that.<ab(700)><ed()>
<sp(20)>Dodge the attacks and try destroying the targets.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Now try dodging upward and downward too.<ab(500)>

<sp(20)>Use it properly and you can dodge almost anything, but
<ab(100)>
rows.notes: Unfinished conjunction is in source. Row603 appears to supply the warning, despite being stored later; preserve the split.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>If you can manage that much, it should be enough.<ab(300)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>So you can handle even that...
All right! How about this?!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>To think you could do this well... Very reassuring.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>This GM! Why is it so sluggish?!<ab(500)>
rows.notes: GM is the mobile-suit name, not a spelled-out acronym.
Training exercise context; instructor declares simulated combat loss, not an actual death.

rows.target: <sp(20)>Stay there a while and think about what you did!<ab(100)><ed()>
<sp(20)>Next, the trainees will face each other in mock combat.<ab(500)>

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>I've had your habits figured out for ages!
You're going to dodge to the right next, aren't you?<ab(300)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>You think it'll all go exactly as you expect?!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Tak... We've finally made it this far.<ab(300)><ed()>

rows.target: <sp(20)>I don't want to lose any more of our friends...<ab(100)>

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>Just that I'm counting on you from here on too.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Contextual rendering of continuing partnership; not a request for a particular service.
Direct opponent established by reply and mock-combat scene.

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>Well, yes...
We know all of each other's tricks, after all.<ab(200)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>...Damage has exceeded the limit.
I lose.<ab(500)><ed()>

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>That was a fine match!
You're a world apart from my rookies.<ab(500)>

<sp(20)>As a precaution, let's limit the output
until the adjustments are complete.<ab(400)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Hm? Looks like our visitor has arrived.<ab(50)><ed()>

rows.target:
<sp(20)>It also uses up vernier energy much faster.
Be careful.<ab(700)><ed()>
rows.notes: Apparent continuation of row566 stored out of order; vernier follows visible HUD terminology.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>No, this is nothing I can't handle.
We're finally getting our official assignment.<ab(0)><off()>

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>That's reassuring, but...
Don't hold me back, all right?<ab(0)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Keep talking, "Lieutenant"!
You've got fewer kills than I do.<ab(0)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>You two, save the bickering for later.
We're starting the exercise.<ab(0)><off()>

and return immediately!<ab(300)><ed()>

this fight hasn't been decided yet!<ab(200)>

Idiomatic rendering of enthusiastic order to fight destructively.

uncertainties: Tak, Uraki, and the Albion identify this content with ACE2 scenarios. It must not be described as verified live ACE3 dialogue without runtime evidence.
Row566 ends with a conjunction. Row603 is its apparent continuation, illustrating that storage order is not full scene order; script-event linkage remains unverified.
Rank rendering uses Ensign for shoui and Lieutenant for chuui. Project-wide continuity-specific rank policy should be checked by the orchestrator.
Row602 arrival subject is unspecified; neutral visitor used based on later Albion arrival.
No speaker table is available; no names were invented for speaker labels.
Drafts preserve full meaning and original controls; display fit and audio timing remain untested.
